Box Plot:


Q: Are there any potential outliers in bench press? 
A: Yes, teen categories, 40s, 50s, 70s, etc. 


Q: What is the general trend of the data shown in the boxplot?
A: The boxplot shows that the general trend of the data increases to a peak and steadily decreases after that.


Q: What do you notice about the age class age categories? 
A: The age groupings aren't consistent. Some span 2 years and some span 10 years. 


Q: Do older or younger lifters show a wider range of strength? 
A: Pretty similar between the two, the 60-64 age category has the widest range. 


Q: Why does it make sense that the age groups are inconsistent?
A: The ranges represent similar/ stable physical conditioning. 


Q: What is a negative reason for using age class? 
A: There are a lot of categories, this can affect who goes to nationals and it may be easier for some compared to others depending on if their age has a smaller pool of contestants.
